# PR Review Checklist: Worker Hub Architecture

**Purpose**: 全栈需求质量审查 — 验证 spec 中 WS 协议、启动协调、重连策略、消息持久化、多 Worker 扩展的需求是否完整、清晰、一致、可衡量
**Created**: 2026-06-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are WS message format requirements defined for all message types (notify, route, route-response, system)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are all hub connection lifecycle events (register, registered, connected, disconnected, ready) specified in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for what happens when a client sends an invalid message? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements specified for Hub startup behavior when the WS port is already in use? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for the Backend's behavior when it receives a duplicate client ID rejection? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is "automatic reconnection logic with exponential backoff" quantified with specific intervals? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "delay database-dependent operations" precisely defined — which operations are delayed and which are not? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "file system watchers can start independently" scoped to specific watchers or all watchers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "real-time" delivery quantified with a specific latency threshold? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are "progress notifications" contents explicitly enumerated (which fields, which events)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "at-least-once delivery semantics" explicitly defined — what constitutes a successful acknowledgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Do User Story 1 acceptance scenarios align with FR-003 (Worker delays DB ops until Backend connects)? [Consistency, Spec §US1, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does FR-008 (message routing by recipient identity) align with the contract's `to`/`from` field design? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Contract]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the notification event types in FR-005 consistent with the existing `notifyAPI` event types (task-complete, task-error, scan-progress)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK015 - Does the "file system watchers in parallel" requirement (FR-004) align with User Story 1 scenario 4? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §US1-S4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Can SC-001 ("Worker starts without database errors") be objectively verified across all startup order combinations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is SC-002 ("within 1 second") measurable across the full chain (Worker → WS → Backend → SSE → Frontend)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-003 ("50+ notifications per second without dropped messages") be measured with deterministic test data? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-004 ("no changes required to Hub or Backend") testable without a future Python worker implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is SC-005 ("reconnects within 10 seconds") measured from disconnection detection or from process restart? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where Backend connects but Worker has not yet started directory watchers? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where Backend WS reconnects mid-scan (progress already in-flight)? [Coverage, Spec §US2-S3]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for Hub behavior when a client disconnects during message routing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements specified for the scenario where PM2 restarts only the Worker but not the Backend? [Coverage, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for multiple Backend clients connecting simultaneously (should be rejected)? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements specified for the scenario where the database file is locked or inaccessible during scanning? [Gap, Coverage]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 - Are edge case requirements defined for WS message size limits (preventing oversized payloads)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements specified for what happens when a client sends messages faster than the Hub can route them? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for the timing gap between "watchers ready" and "DB ready" — what if watchers fire events before DB is ready? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for message ordering when a disconnected client reconnects and receives buffered messages? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements specified for the Hub's behavior when a client's WebSocket connection is in a half-open state? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 - Are logging requirements defined for WS connection events — what fields must be logged? [NFR, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are memory requirements specified for the Hub under sustained 50+ msg/s throughput? [NFR, Gap]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are security requirements defined for WS connections (no auth, but is localhost-only binding sufficient protection)? [NFR, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are observability requirements defined — how to distinguish WS-level failures from application-level failures in logs? [NFR, Spec §FR-012]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 - Is the assumption "Backend is responsible for database schema initialization" validated against the current codebase? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the assumption "PM2 will restart crashed processes automatically" documented as a deployment constraint? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the dependency on the `ws` npm package validated — does it have known issues with the target Node.js version? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK039 - Is the assumption "future Python workers will run on the same NAS machine" consistent with the localhost-only WS binding? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, FR-001]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK040 - Is the term "scanning" used consistently across the spec — does it refer to directory scanning, file reading, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1, §US2]
- [x] CHK041 - Does FR-013 (at-least-once) conflict with existing queue implementation that may not have a `status` field? [Conflict, Spec §FR-013, Data Model] → **RESOLVED**: v1 完整实现，队列消息表增加 `status` 字段（pending/processing/completed）
- [ ] CHK042 - Is the "ready" signal in FR-003 consistent with the "ready" system message in the WS contract — same event or different? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Contract]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items marked `[Gap]` indicate requirements that may need to be added to the spec
- Items marked `[Conflict]` or `[Ambiguity]` should be resolved before implementation
